11727.d: Ghostly warriors can be accessed after completing the Spirit of Summer quest.
11727.ex: A spectral warrior with no axe.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
To access them, the player must have completed the Spirit of Summer quest. In the magic axe hut in deep Wilderness, the player must wear Jennica's ring and operate it when standing right next to the portal to be taken to the Spirit Realm, where there will now be ghostly warriors in place of the magic axes.

The best way to access the portal is by using Wilderness levers in either Ardougne or Edgeville. The player will need a lockpick to access the hut. To leave, the player should just step into the portal and operate the ring again, or run away from the building.

As the Spirit Realm is classed as outside the Wilderness, all methods of teleportation can be used. However, entering the Spirit Realm via the portal is considered a teleport, so players cannot enter if a PKer has teleblocked them. It is also recommended that the player brings some food if planning to stay for a long period of time. Bringing extra food may be desirable because the location is in level 55 Wilderness; however, it is a short distance from the Wilderness lever teleport to the portal, although PKer attack is always possible.

11805.n: Giant golden egg cave (Asgarnian Ice Dungeon)
11805.page: Giant golden egg cave (Asgarnian Ice Dungeon)
11805.d: The giant golden egg cave is a cave located in the final chamber of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, which can be accessed by entering the cave on the northern wall of the chamber with blurite rocks.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, where the entrance to the cave is located, is accessed through a trapdoor south of Port Sarim jail and north of Mudskipper Point. Aside from teleporting with a Dungeoneering cape variant, all methods require navigating through the dungeon by running all the way west, north and east until the icy area is reached.
• Dungeoneering cape variants can be used to teleport to the entrance of Asgarnian Ice Dungeon resource dungeon, directly north of the torches and west of golden egg cave entrance.
• Fairy ring code AIQ goes to Mudskipper Point, run north past Thurgo's Peninsula, then turn back south up the slope to the dungeon trapdoor entrance.
• Port Sarim lodestone, run south through Port Sarim past the jail to the dungeon trapdoor entrance.
